title: Security Deposit Records and Refunds on C&I Contracts
content:
**§ Deposit receipts, refunds and interest** - Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts

## Clauses in force

1. The deposit months and the credit grade basis shown on a deposit receipt record the grade and the months used.
2. A held deposit is refunded in full, with interest at the structure's deposit interest rate, once the contract is closed or rejected and its final bill has posted, as the structure's refund trigger provides; it is not refunded while the contract is active, in termination pending or in holdover.
3. A deposit is refunded only once, and the refund names the deposit it returns through its source deposit reference.
4. An unpaid early termination fee is not netted against the deposit by the care desk.

## Clause no longer in force

The clause that a security deposit is recorded only on a contract that is pending enrollment or active is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Refund by contract status (status read from the contract record)

| Contract status | Deposit refund |
|---|---|
| pending enrollment | not refunded |
| active | not refunded |
| termination pending | not refunded |
| holdover | not refunded |
| closed | refunded in full, once, after the final bill has posted |
| rejected | refunded in full, once, after the final bill has posted |

## Points of judgement

- A deposit receipt that already has a refund naming it is not refunded a second time.
- The care desk does not deduct an unpaid early termination fee from a deposit.
- The refund is the full amount of the deposit it names, together with any interest at the structure's deposit interest rate.

superseded_clauses: A security deposit is recorded only on a contract that is pending_enrollment or active.
